salesforceExclusionReason: API 67 scratch-org execution returns an Internal Salesforce Error when constructing this Database.MergeRequest DTO; the fixture is a local accessor contract and has no portable hosted runtime path. Retain local proof and exclude hosted runtime.

source.content: @isTest private class DatabaseMergeRequestEvidenceTest { @isTest static void mergeRequestAccessorsStoreLocalValues() { Account master = new Account(Name = 'Master'); Database.MergeRequest request = new Database.MergeRequest(); request.setMasterRecord(master); request.setRecordToMergeIds(new List<String>{'001000000000001AAA', '001000000000002AAA'}); request.setAdditionalInformationMap(new List<Datacloud.AdditionalInformationMap>()); System.assertEquals(master, request.getMasterRecord()); System.assertEquals(2, request.getRecordToMergeIds().size()); System.assertEquals(0, request.getAdditionalInformationMap().size()); } }
